title: Junior Development Engineer
content_text:
About the role 
As a Junior Development Engineer, under guidance you'll gain practical experience reviewing development applications, assessing engineering designs, and supporting the delivery of quality infrastructure outcomes. Working within a collaborative and experienced team, you'll develop your knowledge of development engineering, planning legislation, and sustainable development practices. This is an exciting opportunity to build a rewarding engineering career while helping to Rewrite the Future of the Central Coast. 
Applicant Profile 
To be successful in this role, you will have: 
- Currently completing Civil Engineering degree (3rd/4th yr) OR demonstrated solid contemporary experience in Development Engineering. 
- Hold a current Class C or Provisional P1 or Ps Driver's Licence 
- Knowledge related to civil engineering design and land use development and a general knowledge of development and environmental planning 
- An understanding and/or interpretation codes, policies and precures related to civil engineering for land use development 
- Exposure to the Environmental Planning and Assessment Act, the Roads Act and the Local Government Act is required together with an awareness of other related environmental and planning legislations/regulations 
Offer Details 
The commencing salary for this position is up to $80,030.20. Central Coast Council also provides progression opportunities for employees to progress up to the maximum salary of $92,727.03 on completion of assessment of skills and performance plus 12% superannuation 
- We have a temporary full-time role available 
- This role will be able to access a 9 day fortnight 
- We are able to offer hybrid and flexible working conditions for this role - 2 days from home and 3 days onsite 
- This role is located at the Wyong Administration Building 
Want to know more? 
The contact person for this role is John Noakes, Section Manager, Development Engineering. You can contact John on 0417 486 569. 
This position will close for applications at midnight on Sunday, 18 October 2026. 
We will not accept unsolicited resumes or applications being presented by recruitment agencies.

title: Graduate Engineer
content_text:
About Port Waratah
Port Waratah Coal Services is a world-leading logistics and material handling facility, driving economic growth in Newcastle and the Hunter region for over 45 years. We specialise in receiving, stockpiling, blending, and loading coal for export.  
At Port Waratah, we believe in our obligation to operate responsibly and sustainably, and we encourage a culture of shared responsibility and accountability through all levels of our business. We build strong relationships and work cooperatively with our people, customers and our community to continuously improve our performance and contribute to a smart, sustainable and vibrant Newcastle. 
We seek individuals who bring diverse perspectives, a continuous improvement mindset, and align with our core values: caring, excellence, integrity, and progress.  
About the role: 
Start your engineering career working on a scale you won’t find everywhere.
Through our two-year rotational graduate programme, you’ll gain hands-on experience across engineering, asset management and project management, contributing to real projects and working with some of the largest automated machines in NSW.
You’ll work alongside experienced professionals to solve real engineering challenges while building your technical and professional skills through hands-on experience, mentoring and structured development. Based at one of Australia’s leading bulk export facilities in the heart of Newcastle, you’ll gain exposure to complex, large-scale operations and build the skills and experience to set you up for your engineering career.
The programme offers: 
 - A tailored rotational two-year programme aligned to your engineering discipline and career interests.
 - Real world experience in engineering, asset management and project management.
 - Early career development activities, mentoring and on-the-job learning opportunities.
 - A supportive network of experienced engineers and fellow early career professionals.
 - Competitive salary and bonus programme.
Desired Skills and Experience:
What we are looking for:
 - An Engineering degree in Electrical, Structural, Civil or Mechanical Engineering.
 - Graduating by February 2027 or having graduated within the past two years. 
 - Curiosity, initiative and willingness to learn. 
 - Effective communication and problem-solving skills. 
 - An ability to build relationships and work collaboratively with others.
 - Alignment with Port Waratah’s values of Caring, Excellence, Integrity and Progress. 
Benefits:
 - Competitive remuneration package including 18.5% Superannuation and bonus programme
 - Work to Live Culture including generous leave entitlements (16-week parental leave and 5 weeks annual leave)
 - Opportunities for industry networking and professional development and participation in community engagement activities. 
 - Extensive health and wellbeing program with access to gyms and fitness coaching  
For initial inquiries or assistance with your application, please call Adrian Button or Jess O’Neill from Beilby Downing Teal on (02) 4044 0440. 
Applications Close: 22 October 2026

title: Construction Cadets
content_text:
We are currently seeking Construction Cadets to join our Sydney team.
This opportunity is ideally suited to high-performing 2nd or 3rd year students currently studying a Bachelor of Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related discipline at a recognised Australian university.
Our cadetship program is designed to provide exposure across key areas of pre-construction and project delivery, through structured rotations including:
- Estimating
- Contract Administration
- Engineering
- Health & Safety
- Planning & Programming
- Design Coordination
- Site Management
As a Cadet, you will work alongside experienced industry professionals, gaining practical, hands-on experience on major commercial construction projects, while building a strong foundation for a successful career in the industry.
About the Role
- Typically, 4 days per week, structured around study commitments
- Exposure to large-scale commercial construction projects across Sydney
- Mentoring and guidance from experienced construction professionals
- Structured learning and development opportunities
- Opportunity to build a long-term career with one of Australia’s most respected builders
About You
- Currently in your 2nd or 3rd year of a Construction Management, Engineering or related degree
- Passionate about pursuing a career in commercial construction
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn
- Motivated, proactive, and eager to contribute to project teams
- Organised, reliable and able to work effectively in a team environment
Why HY? 
Our cadets are provided with real responsibility, meaningful project exposure, and the support required to develop both technically and professionally. You’ll work on landmark projects, learn from industry leaders, and become part of a collaborative and high-performing culture.
Apply Now
We are looking to hire cadets over the next six months as project requirements evolve. Students interested in future opportunities are encouraged to apply, even if they are not available to commence straight away.
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your interest in commercial construction and why you would like to join Hansen Yuncken.
Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. 
To be eligible for this opportunity, applicants must hold valid working rights.
